mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder_deliveries (user_id, event_id, occurrence_start_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eventId}, #{occurrenceStartAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id, occurrence_start_at) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE reminder_deliveries SET delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, updated_at = #{deliveredAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND delivered_at IS NULL
